title: John Paul and episode 9 as proof of an afterlife
summary: Ky Dickens tells of John Paul and episode 9 as proof of an afterlife, about c. 2024 at Atlanta, Georgia, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: John Paul and I think through John Paul for me that was proof of afterlife

plain: Ky Dickens, the filmmaker behind The Telepathy Tapes, a documentary series about children said to be able to read minds, talks about a person named John Paul. She says that episode 9 of the series, made around 2024 and connected to Atlanta, Georgia, centres on him. Dickens says that through John Paul she found what was, for her, proof of an afterlife.
